observations: Actually viewed this original PNG with view_image. The striped top panel, dotted lower-left panel, crosshatched right panel, and radial lower-left panel are visible and coherent.

No status bar, reader toolbar, footer, modal, tap-zone overlay, error message, or unexplained blank image area is visible. The white outer gutters and internal panel spacing are artwork margins, with no visible separate application inset.

The original capture remains mechanically failed: busy=true and reader_inflight=true, with reader_page=13 but displayed_reader.session.page=12 and visible_reader_page=12. Its three failed checks belong to one unsettled case.
The PNG is visually pure for the displayed artwork, but this fixed-window original capture cannot establish the settled result of the bottom-right action. It is not replaced by the separate retry.
Actually viewed this PNG with view_image. The library shows one imported Chapter 1 item, its tall-panel cover thumbnail, the continue-reading card, category tabs, and bottom navigation.

The title, chapter subtitle, progress indicator, item caption, and navigation labels are readable without apparent overlap or truncation. The saved notification sits above the folio and navigation without obscuring them.
The large white area below the single book is consistent with the sparse library. No error page, missing imported item, unexpected modal, or broken cover is visible.

Actually viewed this PNG with view_image. The tall webtoon artwork shows a black panel segment at the top, the VERTICAL PANEL 3 and VERTICAL PANEL 4 labels, gray and black panels, and the next label entering at the lower viewport edge.

The content continues vertically through the viewport edges as expected for a stepped tall page. The panel gutters and white label bands are part of the visible artwork; no reader chrome, tap-zone overlay, error blank, or separate padded application frame is visible.

Metadata records a settled reader, image_height=11350, viewport_height=2480, and reader_offset=2108, matching the recorded 85-percent step of 2108. The static PNG supports the visible rendering but does not independently measure the interaction distance.
The recorded all-pixel artwork oracle reports zero changed pixels. This is supporting evidence in addition to the actual visual review.

Actually viewed this PNG separately with view_image, even though its hash equals the original vertical-bottom-right PNG. The striped, dotted, crosshatched, and radial artwork panels are visibly intact.

No tap-zone shading, boundary guide, label, toolbar, footer, status bar, or modal is visible. The closed reader visibly preserves the pure-artwork presentation while metadata records show_tap_zones=true, menu=false, and a settled displayed page 12.

The white gutters and speech-balloon interiors belong to the artwork and are not evidence of viewport inset or an empty reader. The recorded zero-pixel oracle supports the visible pure-artwork override; it does not prove hidden hit-zone behavior.

Actually viewed this fresh retry PNG independently with view_image. It shows different artwork from the original capture: a tall radial panel on the left, dotted panels on the right, and a vertically striped lower panel.

The artwork is coherent through the viewport edges, with no reader toolbar, footer, status bar, tap-zone overlay, modal, error blank, or visible application inset. The white gutters and panel spacing are artwork content.

The retry records busy=false and reader_inflight=false, with reader_page, displayed_reader.session.page, and visible_reader_page all equal to 13. The bottom-right advance check and all other mechanical checks pass.

The retry has the same binary, source, and recorded action hash as the original, with a bounded 5000 ms reader tail. Its settled result supplements the original fixed-window failure and does not make the original round mechanically clean or establish a performance improvement.
The recorded all-pixel artwork oracle reports zero changed pixels. The visual conclusion also rests on this separate actual inspection.

findings.description: The original fixed-window capture is not settled: the action has requested page 13, while page 12 remains displayed with busy and reader work still in flight. The original PNG cannot establish the final visual result of that action.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the original failed case and round status. Retain the independently reviewed settled retry as separate supplemental evidence, and carry the original capture-window limitation in the round report. Do not infer a product-logic defect or a performance improvement from these captures alone.

limitations: Only the four original candidate PNGs and the one explicitly supplied fresh retry PNG were loaded. No other PNG, reference image, expected image, or difference image was viewed.
Static PNGs cannot prove invisible hit-zone geometry, physical wake behavior, real e-ink refresh behavior, hardware dithering, or physical-device qualification.
A zero-pixel artwork oracle supports artifact purity but does not replace manual review or prove that a pending reader request has completed.

The original vertical-bottom-right capture remains failed and unsettled. The separate retry supports eventual settlement under its longer bounded tail; it does not retroactively change the original capture or establish improved timing.
This review used existing PNG, JSON, text, and SHA256 evidence only. No application, build, test suite, smoke test, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

The supplied captures do not by themselves establish whether a product defect was introduced in round 1. The single finding tracks the original round-1 capture evidence limitation rather than a confirmed product defect.
